queries.query: Convert an exported internal API endpoint collection into a clean OpenAPI 3.1 YAML specification and partner-facing developer guide with request/response examples.
Audit existing endpoint definitions for naming, pagination, error-schema, and versioning inconsistencies, and produce an API style-lint report plus a v2 deprecation plan.
Design a backwards-compatible v1-to-v2 API versioning and Sunset header migration specification along with a local mock server config for client testing.
Generate realistic mock fixture payloads for blocked frontend screens and a standardized `/health` and `/ready` monitoring contract from the draft OpenAPI file.
Redesign the main analytics dashboard layout from existing screenshots and output updated HTML/CSS with a clear visual hierarchy and spacing tokens.
Consolidate existing UI components into a unified design-system specification with typography scale, semantic light/dark color tokens, and interactive state rules.
Audit the responsive mobile layout and dark-mode contrast from provided code and screenshots, delivering patched CSS variables and accessible component fixes.
Produce a platform-native desktop UI layout specification and accessible keyboard-navigable component structure following native human interface guidelines.
Analyze the site's crawl export and ranking CSV to produce a prioritized technical SEO fix plan addressing unindexed key pages, canonical issues, and parameterized URLs.
Build a revenue-oriented SEO roadmap that rewrites underperforming landing-page title tags/meta descriptions and adds structured Schema.org markup for search and AI answers.
Create a zero-traffic-loss domain and URL migration checklist with 301 redirect mapping rules and post-launch indexation monitoring steps.
Design a topic-cluster internal linking blueprint and content-refresh template based on competitor SERP gaps to lift bottom-of-funnel pages to page one.
Adapt launch copy and media attachments into platform-specific post variants across three channels, generate a scheduled publishing queue payload, and verify live post URLs.
Design an automated multi-platform publishing queue workflow with pre-flight media/character checks, account-session validation, and post-publish visibility confirmation.
Format a long-form article and short-form video assets to meet each target platform's media ratios and character limits, schedule them as drafts, and confirm publication.
Build a pre-publish account-selection and visibility guardrail checklist plus an exception-recovery workflow for expired sessions or failed media uploads.
Diagnose flaky end-to-end checkout tests failing on timeouts and detached elements, and rewrite them using deterministic waits, isolated fixtures, and resilient locators.
Evaluate and recommend a test-automation framework stack, project directory structure, and local-vs-cloud cross-browser and mobile execution matrix.
Produce a phased migration guide from legacy synchronous browser tests to a modern auto-waiting suite and convert core login and checkout flows.
Refactor duplicated test helpers and hardcoded sleeps into composable fixtures, parallel CI sharding configuration, and diagnostic failure artifact collection.
